title: The Supply Charge a Held Fill of More than a Month's Supply Earns on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Plan
content:
Where the fill a pharmacy is holding on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is for more than 30 days' supply, the supply charge the fill earns is worked out from the figure the formulary tier gives by the multiplier the dispensing channel earns.

1. Where the fill is for more than 30 days' supply and the dispensing pharmacy is the plan's mail order pharmacy, the figure the formulary tier gives is multiplied by the plan's mail order multiplier and rounded to two decimal places.
2. Where the fill is for more than 30 days' supply and the dispensing pharmacy carries preferred or standard cost sharing, the figure the formulary tier gives is multiplied by the plan's ninety-day retail multiplier and rounded to two decimal places.
3. Where the fill is for 30 days' supply or fewer, the figure the formulary tier gives stands as the supply charge, whatever the dispensing channel.

| Plan | Mail order multiplier | Ninety-day retail multiplier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 3.0 | 3.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 2.5 | 3.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 2.5 | 3.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 2.0 | 2.5 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 2.0 | 2.5 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 2.0 | 2.5 |

## Boundary cases on a hypothetical figure

Take a figure the formulary tier gives of 13.00 USD on Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP).

- A held fill of 31 days' supply dispensed by the plan's mail order pharmacy: more than 30 days, so the mail order multiplier of 2.5 gives a supply charge of 32.50 USD.
- A held fill of 90 days' supply at a pharmacy carrying preferred cost sharing: the ninety-day retail multiplier of 3.0 gives a supply charge of 39.00 USD.
- A held fill of 90 days' supply at a pharmacy carrying standard cost sharing: the same ninety-day retail multiplier of 3.0 gives a supply charge of 39.00 USD.
- A held fill of exactly 30 days' supply, in any channel: the supply charge is the figure the formulary tier gives, 13.00 USD.

The multiplier acts on the figure the formulary tier gives and on nothing else, and the rounding is to two decimal places and is applied to the product of the multiplication, not to that figure before it.
